title: Safety Authority: CAN loopback (internal ACK) - Degraded -> Fault(DegradedTimeout), zero-frame emission, no CAN error

rules.name: health_fault
rules.note: health = Fault (3) after T_deg 60s in motion-capable Degraded (CH_F NACK)

rules.name: fault_degraded_timeout
rules.note: fault = DegradedTimeout (1); loopback ACKs -> no CAN fault overwrites it

rules.name: can_state_active
rules.note: can_state = Active (0): loopback ACKs internally, no ErrorPassive (key discriminator vs bus leg)

rules.name: no_force_stops
rules.note: force_stops_issued == 0: no ErrorPassive in loopback -> no FORCE-STOP

rules.name: t_deg_accumulated
rules.note: degraded_motion_ms low word grew >= 50s: T_deg 60s accumulation honored

rules.name: stops_issued
rules.note: Controlled stop emitted on Fault (Fault at rest -> CONTROLLED, #45 sec 4)

rules.name: can_tx_count
rules.note: zero-frame emission in loopback (frame records verified post-run)
